bio.text: Dwayne Romero is the Democratic nominee for Colorado's 3rd Congressional District in 2026, having advanced from the June 30 primary.
He served in the U.S. Army from 1984 to 1994, graduated from West Point in 1987 and earned a graduate degree from Harvard Business School in 1997.

According to his campaign website, he served as director of economic development in Gov. John Hickenlooper's administration and also served on his local city council and school board, including as board president from 2020 to 2021.
The site says he owns and operates a property management company on the Western Slope.
